libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: synth-entry mode: always merge full src-derived components even when componentSrcMap pins one name (disambiguation, not enumeration) — upstream's components.length-gate suppressed full derivation
libOverrides.dts.mjs: allow all-caps TLDR component past the enum-name heuristic; and THE critical fix — synth-entry mode has no dist/.d.ts at all, so upstream's .d.ts-only loadDts/propsBodyFor found zero source files and every component fell back to the empty-stub props. Forked to parse cfg.srcDir's real .tsx/.ts sources through cfg.tsconfig when no .d.ts tree exists, extended the call-signature fallback to scan in-package source directly (covers inline-object-literal prop types with no named <Name>Props, and forwardRef), and depth-capped typeText's expansion of non-global named types (+ an unresolved-identifier safety net) since emitted .d.ts files only `import * as React` — a bare reference to any other named type would be invalid standalone TS
